conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Chalkboard
style.description: A real classroom chalkboard filmed in 3D: a dusty green slate in a worn oak frame with a chalk tray (sticks, a felt eraser, dust) on a painted wall, side-lit by window daylight. Grainy, pressure-varying hand-drawn chalk writes itself stroke by stroke over ghosts of old lessons; a floating chalk stick shedding dust follows the stroke tip, the eraser lifts off the tray to wipe a region and leaves a ghost.
motion: Strokes draw on along their length in natural writing order: letters stroke by stroke, short pen-up hops between strokes, slower landings and quick lifts.
Headings are double-stroked (each stroke retraced fast with a small offset); fills are quick hatch scribbles; emphasis = double underline or a loose circle.
A floating chalk stick rides the active stroke tip, hops between strokes, drifts away in long pauses and sheds closed-form dust that falls and fades.
Erasing: the felt eraser lifts off the tray, wipes the region in boustrophedon rows (leaving a ghost and a dusty smear), and returns.

Camera: square-on and at eye level with what it frames (boardShot), gentle push/pan between computed shots that always keep the heading and the active writing inside the safe area (framingReport); hold during writing.

objects.procedural: 8 x 5 m painted sage plaster wall plane behind the board

3.4 x 1.9 m green slate (mottled, ghosts of old lessons, chalk canvas through a tooth shader) in a worn oak frame with a chalk tray holding chalk sticks, a felt eraser and dust; floating chalk stick + falling dust particles

notes.mechanism: Board = planChalk(PROGRAM) painted per frame as a pure function of t (committed-prefix cache rebuilt on backward seeks). Scratches, taps and eraser sounds are scoreFromEvents(plan.events, chalkVoices()).
